about: Client groups tune a class within its level. Rules marked hard are never broken. Soft settings nudge the choices.

defaultGroup.note: Most of Jay's clients are older.

summary.value: Gentler versions, more support, slower changes, lighter loads, longer warm-up and wind-down.

maxSpinalFlexion.note: Avoid deep loaded spinal flexion. A small curl (HNS) is fine.

maxFloorVisits.note: Minimize getting up and down from the floor. At most one stretch of floor work per class.

paceFactor.note: Slower transitions, so each exercise gets about 20 percent more time and the class has fewer exercises.

challengeBias.note: Prefers the easier exercises allowed at the level.

springAdvice.value: Start at the lighter load. Add spring only if form stays clean.
springAdvice.note: Lighter loads. Shown on the cue card key.

summary.value: The standard version of each level.

allowInversions.note: Allowed when the level allows them.

maxFloorVisits.note: Still keeps getting up and down low.

summary.value: More challenging variations within the level and faster pacing.

allowInversions.note: Allowed when the level allows them.

paceFactor.note: Faster pacing, so more exercises fit in each block.

challengeBias.note: Prefers the harder exercises allowed at the level.

springAdvice.value: Springs as listed. Go heavier or lighter to add challenge.
